857669956.annotation: This will help you and your ally survive more! It also provides you with some more range. |Upgrade into: Divine Barrier|

754480263.annotation: Makes it easier to hit enemies with Splatter (1)! Also makes you reach your 4.8k Spirit Spike. |Upgrade into: Greater Expansion|

2121044373.annotation: Has to charge up, so after using Echo Shard, it will not trigger instantly on your 2nd Splatter (1).

2603935618.annotation: An easy to trigger anti-heal. Gives you a nice heal when you kill someone, as long as they had the effect on them. This can be used against Victor.

1644605047.annotation: Useful against Mirage's Tornado, Bebop's Hook, Abrams' Charge, Haze's Sleep, Paige's immobilize, any stuns (Including getting parried!) and more!

1378931225.annotation: Become immune to bullets! But mind the on-hit effects like Tesla Bullets or Mercurial Magnum! Useful against: Drifter, Haze, Silver, Venator, Vyper, Wraith and more.

2163598980.annotation: Very useful if the enemy team is mostly Spirit oriented. (Check the colored bars when holding TAB!)

1414025773.annotation: Parry ANYTHING. This means almost any abilities such as Geist's Ultimate, Shiv's Ultimate, Lash's Ultimate, etc...

334300056.annotation: Allows you to move around with ease, double air-dash and be more mobile in general!

3270001687.annotation: Allows you to escape with ease especially if used vertically! Very good against a gun-heavy team. A must-have if you use Goo Ball (4) a lot.

865958998.annotation: A bit of spirit power, and some nice mobility to roam around. Make sure to go through Cosmic Veils (The foggy walls) to trigger the active effect!

3585132399.annotation: Lots of bonus health. The passive health regen will allow you to never have to go back to Base to heal! The movement speed bonus will help you move around too.

600033864.annotation: A great tool to rotate around the map and dive right into the fight.

2447176615.annotation: The weakest option but also the simplest. It just makes you move around faster. You will NOT reach the 4.8k Vitality spike by buying this one. So buy another T2 Vitality to reach it!

951866250.annotation: Basically an Automatic Counterspell against CC. Works against Cursed Relic. If facing many CC, buy Unstoppable. Very useful against Lash's Ult, Vyper's Ult, Bebop's Hook, Doorman's Ult and much more!

1955841979.annotation: For survivability. Allows you to survive with burst spirit damage. Very useful against Apollo, Bebop, Grey Talon, Lash, Mirage, and more.

1662311306.annotation: Dispel Magic but stronger, and for an ally too! Works on Ultimate-type debuffs (Drifter, Pocket...)

3357231760.annotation: This is your pick against many CC in the late game. This especially helps if you tend to get jumped, or to get shutdown while using Goo Ball (4).

3028234315.annotation: For cooldown reduction & survivability. You'll take a lot of spirit damage late game, so you'll get a lot of cooldown reduction. Works well with Goo Ball (4).

3261353684.annotation: Get your abilities back faster, such as the Cube (2) & Goo Ball (4)! |Upgrade into: Transcendent Cooldown|

3577481646.annotation: A considerable amount of lifesteal, and lots more damage for Splatter (1). Keep in mind that with Echo Shard, it won't proc for both Splatters in quick succession, since it has a cooldown.

630839635.annotation: Huge powerspike. You basically double your burst damage!

2519598785.annotation: A ton more damage for your whole kit, but also more healing with your Cube (2)!

343572757.annotation: Anti-Healing & Extra damage. Your double Splatter (1) with Echo Shard can easily activate this!

3005970438.annotation: ONLY get this if you bought Spirit Burn OR Alchemical Fire! It stacks easily with it. This will amplify YOUR damage, not your teammates'.

915014646.annotation: Lower the cooldown of all your abitilies but also your items, like Echo Shard, Mystic Reverb and more!

2059712766.annotation: Health but also Stamina upon use. Only take if you tend to frontline a lot and facing ability-spamming enemies.

1804594021.annotation: You can pull people that are in your Cube (2), very useful when enemy teams tend to have enemies like Mo&Krill, Bebop, Holliday, etc... who can pull your allies away.

1797283378.annotation: For damage & survivability. If you have Boundless Spirit, the Spirit gained is increased! Use it before using Splatter (1)!

1219329868.annotation: Use it before Splatter (1) for more damage! |Upgrade into: Focus Lens|

1976391348.annotation: A strong slow and more damage. Consider it if you tend to go in a lot, or use Goo Ball (4) quite often!

619484391.annotation: This item can counter Indomitable. Useful against anyone who relies on their abilities, such as Apollo, Calico, Pocket, Lady Geist, Victor and more.

1152158042.annotation: Throw a SQUID from the DEEP. Pull them into one point and Splatter them! Useful against: Apollo, Calico, Celeste, Holliday, Infernus and many more.

3812615317.annotation: Same as Cold Front, but with more damage and CC potential!

2142980412.annotation: Debuff and more damage. A very powerful item to kill a specific target! Increases your burst damage considerably.

1932939246.annotation: This can stack Escalating Exposure easily. It'll also allow your team to take down Mid-Boss or Objectives faster.

395867183.annotation: Use it with your Alt-Fire (Right Click) to land it easily. Once you have enough Spirit, this can proc Spellbreaker before you use Splatter (1)! |Can be sold for a slot|

690458959.annotation: Use it with your Alt-Fire (Right Click) to deal a nice burst of damage! Shares its cooldown with Mystic Shot, meaning you'll always use both at the same time!

1813726886.annotation: Useful against: Apollo, Calico, Celeste, Mina, Pocket, Rem and more.

3144988365.annotation: A decent anti-heal that deals damage scaling with Spirit. Useful against: Abrams, Billy, Mo&Krill, Shiv, Silver and more. DO NOT USE AGAINST VICTOR.

2061878743.annotation: More useful than Metal Skin when gun-focused characters have on-hit effects. Useful against: Celeste, Drifter, Graves, Haze, Infernus, Mina and more.

1254091416.annotation: To shutdown ultimates or flying enemies! Useful against: Bebop, Celeste, Grey Talon, Kelvin, Lash, Seven and more.

2617435668.annotation: If an enemy gets out of control, this will help shut them down. Careful of when to use it if they get Unstoppable or Indomitable! Useful against: Anyone.

1763073141.annotation: Will grant you a charge of Puddle Punch (3) by dealing gun damage, but also melee damage, which includes Puddle Punch (3) itself!

3294954488.annotation: Increases the size of Splatter (1) for a large amount for easier hits with bounces to hit multiple enemies and empower your gun!

709540378.annotation: Will help you farm & deal more damage with your gun. Always use on a Tier 3 Neutral enemy (The biggest, one eyed, alien monster in the jungle).

4075861416.annotation: Same as Spirit Shredder Bullets, but with further shredding!

1798666702.annotation: To embush people, but also rotate around the map with ease.

3884003354.annotation: Land a headshot before using Splatter (1)!

3399065363.annotation: More Sprint speed and some out of combat health regen. |Upgrade into: Veil Walker|

1437614329.annotation: This can be triggered by Puddle Punch (3). You can also simply hit troopers for some healing too, but reduced. |Can be sold for a slot|

876563814.annotation: Some decent healing with your double Splatter (1)! |Upgrade into: Infuser|

1047818222.annotation: Lowers the duration of Infernus' Burn, any form of stuns, silence, immobilize and more. |Upgrade into: Spellbreaker|

112198670.annotation: This item is very useful against constant Spirit Damage.

805079544.annotation: If you are taking too much consistant Weapon damage, this will help but isn't as effective as other options.

3361075077.annotation: Send back some of the damage you take! Useful against: Haze, Drifter, Wraith, Vyper and more.

3731635960.annotation: Removes Bebop's Bomb, Infernus' Burn, and more! Does NOT remove Pocket's Affliction.

3140772621.annotation: Very useful if the enemy team is mostly Bullet oriented. (Check the colored bars when holding TAB!)

2956256701.annotation: Useful if you tend to teamfight a lot, heals a considerable amount in mid-game.

1250307611.annotation: For mobility & survivability. Very useful against characters who rely on their gun to deal damage!

2820116164.annotation: If you tend to use Goo Ball (4) a lot and want more survivability.

2462046703.annotation: Only buy as 1st item. Keep the egg until your next item is Echo Shard! Then, cash it in to help getting Echo Shard!

2922054143.annotation: Useful against: Haze, Wraith, Drifter, Infernus, Mina, Mirage, McGinnis, Seven, Vindicta, Vyper, and Warden.

3776945997.annotation: One more charge of Puddle Punch (3) for lane harrasment! |Can be sold for a slot|

465043967.annotation: This can be triggered by Puddle Punch (3). Try to use your it first before Splatter (1) for extra damage! |Upgrade into: Spirit Snatch|

2081037738.annotation: Easily triggered by your first Splatter (1) before using Echo Shard. |Upgrade into: Escalating Exposure|

1925087134.annotation: Useful against: Haze, Wraith, Drifter, Infernus, Mina, Mirage, McGinnis, Seven, Vindicta, Vyper, and Warden.

3190916303.annotation: This can be triggered by Puddle Punch (3). They get weaker, and you get stronger!

1292979587.annotation: More damage for Splatter (1), and allows you to use your gun more.

2533252781.annotation: Useful against: Anyone but especially Lash & Bebop.

2417568017.annotation: If you tend to go in with Goo Ball (4), and want more damage while doing so.
